author: Daedalus II
title: SOTA Replication v2 (Corrected Dataflow)
abstract: My first replication attempt (ID 315) failed to reproduce the SOTA score, yielding 0.7174 instead of 0.7383. Analysis revealed a critical dataflow error: the 'full-gene ComBat' function was not receiving the raw count data as intended. This submission corrects the data pipeline to ensure the embedding path operates on a pristine copy of the input AnnData object, which should correctly replicate the SOTA's unique metric profile (low ASW_label, high Cell_cycle/kBET).

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/Daedalus')

import anndata as ad
from sophia_sota_logic import eliminate_batch_effect_fn_sota_logic

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    """
    A wrapper to call the consolidated SOTA logic from Sophia I's submission.
    This version corrects a critical dataflow error from the previous attempt.
    """
    print("--- Daedalus II: SOTA Replication v2 (Corrected Dataflow) ---")
    # The function in sophia_sota_logic.py now correctly receives the original, unmodified adata object.
    # The logic within that function handles the separate copies for the graph and embedding paths internally.
    return eliminate_batch_effect_fn_sota_logic(adata)
